best_idea: A timed server snapshot of the results, sorted lazily once per reload per board, with the win rate in basis points and no-game players kept off the rate board.
decision_why: Keep the snapshot and lazy-sort shape for ladder rows, but fix the failed-reload, comparator and no-game defects and add a tie-break, because a board that empties or reorders wrongly on a reload is worse than a stale one.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a failed reload leaves the previous list on screen, that the win-rate board never lists a player with 0 games, that a 2-0 record (100%) ranks above a 3-1 record (75%) on the rate board, and that two players with equal wins keep a fixed order across reloads.
